Faça uma breve pausa na parte inferior e, em seguida, contraia os glúteos e os músculos posteriores das coxas para elevar o tronco de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições e depois troque de lado.
Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in your right hand.
Shift your weight onto your left leg and lift your right foot slightly off the ground.
Keeping your back straight, hinge forward at the hips and lower the dumbbell towards the ground.
At the same time, extend your right leg straight behind you, maintaining a slight bend in your left knee.
Lower the dumbbell until your torso and right leg are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment, then engage your glutes and hamstrings to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
Fique em pé com os pés afastados na largura do quadril, segurando um halter na mão direita.
Transfira o peso para a perna esquerda e eleve ligeiramente o pé direito do chão.
Mantendo as costas retas, incline o tronco para a frente a partir do quadril e abaixe o halter em direção ao chão.
Ao mesmo tempo, estenda a perna direita para trás, mantendo uma leve flexão no joelho esquerdo.
Abaixe o halter até que o tronco e a perna direita fiquem paralelos ao chão.
Faça uma breve pausa e contraia os glúteos e os músculos posteriores das coxas para retornar à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições e depois troque de lado.
Sit on the edge of a bench or have someone hold your feet down.
Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Sente-se na borda de um banco ou peça para alguém segurar seus pés.
Deite-se de costas, com os joelhos flexionados e os pés apoiados no chão.
Coloque as mãos atrás da cabeça, com os cotovelos apontados para os lados.
Contraia o abdômen e eleve lentamente a parte superior do corpo, curvando o tronco para a frente até atingir um ângulo de 45 graus.
Faça uma breve pausa no alto e retorne lentamente à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and arms extended in front of you.
Lift your right foot off the ground and extend it forward.
Slowly lower your body down by bending your left knee and pushing your hips back.
Keep your chest up and your back straight as you lower yourself down.
Lower until your left thigh is parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your left heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
Fique em pé com os pés afastados na largura dos ombros e os braços estendidos à sua frente.
Eleve o pé direito do chão e estenda-o para a frente.
Abaixe lentamente o corpo flexionando o joelho esquerdo e levando o quadril para trás.
Mantenha o peito elevado e as costas retas enquanto abaixa o corpo.
Desça até a coxa esquerda ficar paralela ao chão ou até onde conseguir confortavelmente.
Faça uma breve pausa embaixo e, em seguida, empurre o chão com o calcanhar esquerdo para retornar à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições e depois troque de perna.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell vertically against your chest with both hands.
Keeping your chest up and core engaged, lower your body down into a squat position by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Fique em pé com os pés afastados na largura dos ombros, segurando um halter na vertical contra o peito com as duas mãos.
Mantendo o peito elevado e o abdômen contraído, abaixe o corpo até a posição de agachamento, levando o quadril para trás e dobrando os joelhos.
Continue abaixando até que as coxas fiquem paralelas ao chão ou até onde conseguir descer confortavelmente.
Faça uma breve pausa embaixo e empurre o chão com os calcanhares para retornar à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms fully extended and your palms facing away from you.
Engage your core and lift your knees towards your chest, twisting your torso to the side as you do so.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side, twisting your torso in the opposite direction.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
elevação de joelhos oblíqua na barra fixa
Fique pendurado em uma barra fixa com os braços totalmente estendidos e as palmas das mãos voltadas para longe do corpo.
Contraia o abdômen e eleve os joelhos em direção ao peito, girando o tronco para o lado enquanto faz o movimento.
Faça uma pausa no topo do movimento e, em seguida, abaixe lentamente as pernas de volta à posição inicial.
Repita do outro lado, girando o tronco na direção oposta.
Continue alternando os lados pelo número desejado de repetições.
Stand next to a sturdy support and hold it with one or both hands.
Lift one leg out in front of you and balance on the other.
Sit your hips back and bend your knee, lowering as far as you can control.
Keep your heel down and your knee tracking over your toes.
Press through your foot to stand, using the support only as needed, then switch legs.
Grab the pull-up bar with a shoulder-width grip, palms facing away from you.
Hang freely with your arms fully extended.
Engage your back muscles and pull your body up towards the bar until your chin is above the bar.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
barra fixa pegada na largura dos ombros
Segure a barra fixa com as mãos afastadas na largura dos ombros e as palmas voltadas para a frente.
Fique livremente suspenso, com os braços completamente estendidos.
Contraia os músculos das costas e puxe o corpo para cima, em direção à barra, até que o queixo fique acima dela.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo e, depois, abaixe lentamente o corpo até a posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms fully extended and your palms facing away from you.
Engage your core and lift your legs up by flexing your hips and knees until your thighs are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
elevação de quadril e pernas na barra fixa
Fique pendurado em uma barra fixa com os braços totalmente estendidos e as palmas das mãos voltadas para longe do corpo.
Contraia o abdômen e eleve as pernas flexionando os quadris e os joelhos até que as coxas fiquem paralelas ao chão.
Faça uma pausa no topo do movimento e, em seguida, abaixe lentamente as pernas de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip.
Let the dumbbells hang in front of your thighs, with your arms fully extended and your palms facing your body.
Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, exhale and lift the dumbbells straight up towards your chin, leading with your elbows.
Continue lifting until the dumbbells are at shoulder height, with your elbows pointing out to the sides.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
remada alta com halter (vista de trás)
Fique em pé com os pés afastados na largura dos ombros, segurando um halter em cada mão com uma pegada pronada.
Deixe os halteres pendentes à frente das coxas, com os braços completamente estendidos e as palmas voltadas para o corpo.
Mantendo as costas retas e o abdômen contraído, expire e eleve os halteres verticalmente em direção ao queixo, conduzindo o movimento com os cotovelos.
Continue elevando até que os halteres alcancem a altura dos ombros, com os cotovelos apontados para os lados.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo e, em seguida, inspire e abaixe lentamente os halteres até a posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
Lie face down on a leg curl machine with your legs extended and your ankles hooked under the padded lever.
Place your hands on the side handles of the machine for support.
Keeping your upper body stationary, exhale and curl your legs upward as far as possible.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your hamstrings.
Slowly lower your legs back to the starting position while inhaling.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Deite-se de bruços em uma máquina flexora, com as pernas estendidas e os tornozelos encaixados sob o rolo acolchoado.
Coloque as mãos nas alças laterais da máquina para obter apoio.
Mantendo a parte superior do corpo imóvel, expire e flexione as pernas para cima o máximo possível.
Mantenha a posição contraída por uma breve pausa enquanto contrai os músculos posteriores das coxas.
Abaixe lentamente as pernas de volta à posição inicial enquanto inspira.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
weighted triceps dip on high parallel bars
Position yourself between two parallel bars with your hands gripping the bars and your arms fully extended.
Bend your elbows and lower your body until your upper arms are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment, then push through your palms to straighten your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
mergulho para tríceps em paralelas altas com peso
Posicione-se entre duas barras paralelas, segurando-as com as mãos e mantendo os braços totalmente estendidos.
Flexione os cotovelos e abaixe o corpo até que os braços fiquem paralelos ao chão.
Faça uma breve pausa e, em seguida, empurre com as palmas das mãos para estender os braços e retornar à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
Lie on your side with your legs extended and your head supported by your arm.
Hold your upper arm against your side and bend your elbow to curl your forearm towards your shoulder.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your forearm back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
rosca bíceps deitado de lado peso corporal
Deite-se de lado com as pernas estendidas e a cabeça apoiada no braço.
Mantenha o braço junto à lateral do corpo e flexione o cotovelo, levando o antebraço em direção ao ombro.
Faça uma breve pausa no alto e, em seguida, abaixe lentamente o antebraço de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
Sit on a bench with your legs spread apart and your feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand and place your elbow on the inside of your thigh, just above the knee.
With your palm facing up, curl the dumbbell towards your shoulder while keeping your upper arm stationary.
Squeeze your biceps at the top of the movement, then slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
rosca concentrada de bíceps na perna
Sente-se em um banco com as pernas afastadas e os pés apoiados no chão.
Segure um halter com uma mão e posicione o cotovelo na parte interna da coxa, logo acima do joelho.
Com a palma voltada para cima, flexione o cotovelo para elevar o halter em direção ao ombro, mantendo o braço imóvel.
Contraia o bíceps no topo do movimento e, em seguida, abaixe lentamente o halter até a posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições e, em seguida, troque de braço.
Kneel down on the ground with your knees hip-width apart.
Place your hands on the ground in front of you, shoulder-width apart, fingers pointing forward.
Extend your legs straight behind you, balancing on your toes and hands, forming a straight line from head to heels.
Bend your elbows and lower your upper body towards the ground, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your hands to straighten your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
extensão de tríceps ajoelhado peso corporal
Ajoelhe-se no chão com os joelhos afastados na largura do quadril.
Apoie as mãos no chão à sua frente, afastadas na largura dos ombros e com os dedos apontados para a frente.
Estenda as pernas para trás, apoiando-se nas pontas dos pés e nas mãos e formando uma linha reta da cabeça aos calcanhares.
Flexione os cotovelos e abaixe a parte superior do corpo em direção ao chão, mantendo os cotovelos próximos ao tronco.
Faça uma breve pausa embaixo e, em seguida, empurre o chão com as mãos para estender os braços e retornar à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
Start by lying face down on the ground with your legs extended and your hands placed directly under your shoulders.
Engage your core and press through your palms to lift your upper body off the ground, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Pause at the top for a moment, squeezing your upper back muscles.
Slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
elevação de cotovelo - flexão de braços invertida
Comece deitado de bruços no chão, com as pernas estendidas e as mãos posicionadas diretamente sob os ombros.
Contraia o abdômen e pressione as palmas das mãos para elevar a parte superior do corpo do chão, mantendo os cotovelos próximos às laterais do corpo.
Faça uma breve pausa no ponto mais alto, contraindo os músculos da parte superior das costas.
Abaixe lentamente o corpo até a posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, and hold a towel with one hand.
Bend forward at the waist, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Extend your arm fully, allowing the towel to hang in front of you.
Pull the towel towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the towel back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
Fique em pé com os pés afastados na largura dos ombros, os joelhos levemente flexionados e segure uma toalha com uma mão.
Incline o tronco para a frente a partir da cintura, mantendo as costas retas e o abdômen contraído.
Estenda completamente o braço, deixando a toalha pendurada à sua frente.
Puxe a toalha em direção ao peito, aproximando as escápulas.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo e, depois, abaixe lentamente a toalha até a posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições e, depois, troque de braço.
Lie on your side with your legs extended and stacked on top of each other.
Prop yourself up on your forearm, keeping your elbow directly below your shoulder.
Engage your core and lift your hips off the ground, creating a straight line from your head to your feet.
While keeping your core engaged, lift your top leg as high as possible without rotating your hips.
Pause for a moment at the top, then lower your leg back down.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
abdução de quadril em prancha lateral
Deite-se de lado com as pernas estendidas e sobrepostas.
Apoie-se no antebraço, mantendo o cotovelo diretamente abaixo do ombro.
Contraia o abdômen e eleve o quadril do chão, formando uma linha reta da cabeça aos pés.
Mantendo o abdômen contraído, eleve a perna de cima o máximo possível sem girar o quadril.
Faça uma breve pausa no ponto mais alto e, em seguida, abaixe a perna.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições e depois troque de lado.
Start by lying on your side with your legs extended and stacked on top of each other.
Prop yourself up on your forearm, keeping your elbow directly below your shoulder.
Engage your core and lift your hips off the ground, creating a straight line from your head to your feet.
While maintaining the side plank position, lift your top leg towards the ceiling, keeping it straight.
Slowly lower your leg back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
adução de quadril em prancha lateral
Comece deitado de lado, com as pernas estendidas e sobrepostas.
Apoie-se no antebraço, mantendo o cotovelo diretamente abaixo do ombro.
Contraia o abdômen e eleve o quadril do chão, formando uma linha reta da cabeça aos pés.
Mantendo a posição de prancha lateral, eleve a perna de cima em direção ao teto, mantendo-a estendida.
Abaixe lentamente a perna de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições e depois troque de lado.
lying single straight leg hip extension
Lie face down with your legs straight and your forehead on your hands.
Raise one straight leg a few inches off the floor.
Pause briefly at the top without arching your lower back.
Lower under control and repeat, then switch legs.
extensão de quadril com perna estendida deitado
Stand tall and interlace your fingers, then raise your arms overhead.
Press your arms slightly back and lift your chest without arching your lower back.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
alongamento de peito acima da cabeça
Stand tall with your arms out to the sides and your hands at shoulder height or slightly lower.
Have your partner hold your wrists and slowly pull your arms back until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
alongamento de peito em pé assistido
Sit upright on a bench or chair with your hands behind your head or arms out wide.
Have your partner stand behind you and gently draw your elbows or wrists back.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
Stand beside a wall or doorframe and place your forearm on it with your elbow bent to 90 degrees.
Step forward and turn your body away until you feel the stretch across your chest.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
alongamento de peito com braço flexionado
Stand facing a wall corner and place a forearm on each wall at about shoulder height.
Step one foot forward and lean your chest into the corner until you feel a stretch.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
alongamento de peito no canto da parede
Stand tall and clasp your hands behind your back with straight arms.
Lift your hands up and away from your body while opening your chest.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
standing chest stretch (with training wall bars)
Stand beside wall bars and grip a bar at about shoulder height with one hand.
Slowly turn your body away from the bars until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
alongamento de peito em pé (com espaldar)
Stand or sit tall with your arms extended behind you at hip to shoulder height.
Have your partner hold your wrists and gently pull your arms back and slightly up.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
alongamento de peito assistido puxando as costas
Kneel in front of a bench or chair and rest your forearms or hands on it.
Sit your hips back and let your chest drop toward the floor until you feel the stretch.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
Sit or stand with your hands clasped behind your head and your elbows wide.
Have your partner pull your elbows back as you gently tilt your trunk forward.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
alongamento de peito assistido com flexão do tronco
Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and reach both straight arms behind you.
Lift your arms slightly and open your chest without leaning back.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
alongamento de peito com braços estendidos para trás
Stand tall and raise both straight arms overhead with your palms facing forward.
Reach up and slightly back, keeping your ribs down and your core lightly braced.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
alongamento com braço estendido acima da cabeça
Lie on your back with your arms stretched out straight to the sides or overhead.
Have your partner gently press your wrists or arms down toward the floor.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
alongamento assistido deitado com braços estendidos (peito)
assisted pulling arms in prone position chest stretch
Lie face down with your arms out to the sides and your forehead resting on the floor.
Have your partner hold your wrists and slowly lift your arms up and back.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
alongamento de peito assistido puxando os braços de bruços
Sit or stand tall and hold the edge of the seat or a hand behind your back to anchor one shoulder down.
Tilt your head toward the opposite shoulder until you feel a stretch along your neck.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
Stand tall and bring one arm across your chest at shoulder height.
Hook it with your other forearm and pull it gently closer to your chest.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
alongamento de ombro com braço envolvendo
Stand tall and bring one straight arm across your chest.
Use your other hand to hold it just above the elbow and draw it closer to you.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
Stand or sit and clasp your hands or hold a support in front of you at chest height.
Round your upper back and push your hands forward while dropping your head between your arms.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
alongamento de costas superiores alcançando à frente
Stand with your feet hip-width apart and reach both arms forward at chest height.
Round your upper back and spread your shoulder blades apart as you reach farther.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
standing reach up back rotation stretch
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and reach one arm overhead.
Rotate your upper body gently away from the raised arm and reach up and over.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
alongamento de rotação das costas em pé alcançando para cima
Stand tall and reach both arms overhead with your palms facing each other.
Reach up and lean slightly back, keeping your lower back relaxed and your ribs down.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
alongamento de costas alcançando para cima
Lie on your back with your arms overhead and your legs straight.
Reach your fingertips up and your toes down, as if you want to get taller.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
two handed hang back stretch (with training wall bars)
Grip a wall bar overhead with both hands and walk your feet out slightly.
Let your body hang and sink your hips back, relaxing your upper back and shoulders.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
alongamento de costas pendurado com as duas mãos (com espaldar)
Hold the cable attachment or handles with both hands at about chest height.
Lean back with straight arms and sit your hips back until you feel your back lengthen.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
alongamento de costas com suspensão no cabo
Stand tall and hold a pole or frame with one hand above head height.
Lean away from the arm and sit your hips slightly back to feel a stretch along your side.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and raise one arm overhead.
Lean to the opposite side from the raised arm, reaching over without twisting.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
Sit on the floor or a bench with your knees slightly bent and your feet flat.
Round your back and fold your chest toward your thighs, letting your arms hang down.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
alongamento do extensor do tronco inferior sentado
seated lower trunk extensor lateral flexor stretch
Sit tall on a chair or bench with your feet flat on the floor.
Fold forward and reach your hands toward one foot, letting your trunk bend slightly to that side.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
alongamento do extensor e flexor lateral do tronco inferior sentado
Sit on a bench or chair with your feet flat and your knees apart.
Bend forward from your hips and let your head and arms hang between your knees.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
alongamento de costas sentado inclinado à frente
Sit tall with your legs crossed or your feet flat and place one hand on the floor beside you.
Reach your other arm up and over your head toward the side, lengthening along your flank.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
sitting cross legged reach forward stretch
Sit on the floor with your legs crossed and your back tall.
Walk your hands forward along the floor and fold from your hips until you feel a stretch.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
alongamento sentado de pernas cruzadas alcançando à frente
Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat.
Draw both knees toward your chest and hold them with your hands.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
alongamento do extensor do tronco inferior reclinado
sitting feet together reach forward stretch
Sit on the floor with the soles of your feet together and your knees falling out.
Hold your feet and fold forward from your hips, keeping your spine long.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
alongamento sentado com pés juntos alcançando à frente
Lie on your back with both legs extended.
Pull one knee toward your chest with both hands while the other leg stays flat.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
alongamento de joelho ao peito deitado
Stand tall, using a wall for balance if needed.
Lift one knee and pull it gently toward your chest with both hands.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
alongamento de joelho ao peito em pé
Start on your hands and knees with your hands under your shoulders.
Place one hand behind your head and rotate your elbow up toward the ceiling.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
alongamento de rotação das costas ajoelhado
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms at chest height.
Rotate your upper body to one side, keeping your hips facing forward.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
alongamento de rotação das costas em pé

Deite-se de bruços no banco, com as pernas estendidas e as tiras de tornozelo presas aos pés.
Segure as alças do banco para manter a estabilidade.
Dobre os joelhos e leve as pernas em direção aos glúteos, contraindo os músculos posteriores das coxas.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo do movimento e abaixe lentamente as pernas de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and your upper arms stationary.
Exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the weights until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Rosca bíceps com halteres (com arm blaster)
Fique em pé com o corpo ereto, segurando um halter em cada mão e as palmas voltadas para a frente.
Mantenha os cotovelos próximos ao tronco e os braços imóveis.
Expire e flexione os cotovelos para elevar os pesos enquanto contrai os bíceps.
Continue elevando os pesos até contrair completamente os bíceps e os halteres chegarem à altura dos ombros.
Mantenha a posição contraída por uma breve pausa, contraindo bem os bíceps.
Inspire e comece a abaixar lentamente os halteres de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your torso.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and rotate the palms of your hands until they are facing forward.

Now, while holding your upper arm stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the weights until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Then, inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Rosca martelo com halteres (com arm blaster)

Mantenha os cotovelos próximos ao tronco e gire as palmas das mãos até ficarem voltadas para a frente.
Agora, mantendo os braços imóveis, expire e flexione os cotovelos para elevar os pesos enquanto contrai os bíceps.
Continue elevando os pesos até contrair completamente os bíceps e os halteres chegarem à altura dos ombros.
Mantenha a posição contraída por uma breve pausa, contraindo bem os bíceps.
Em seguida, inspire e comece a abaixar lentamente os halteres de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número recomendado de repetições.

Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl one dumbbell up towards your shoulder while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the dumbbell until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbell is at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat the movement with the opposite arm.
Continue alternating arms for the desired number of repetitions.
rosca alternada com halteres (com arm blaster)

Mantendo os braços imóveis, expire e flexione um cotovelo para elevar o halter em direção ao ombro enquanto contrai o bíceps.

Mantenha a posição contraída por uma breve pausa, contraindo bem o bíceps.
Inspire e abaixe lentamente o halter de volta à posição inicial.

Continue alternando os braços pelo número desejado de repetições.

rosca bíceps com barra EZ (com arm blaster)

Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
